title: Upper bound for a function’s range
statement: Let $\iota$ be an index type and let $g:\iota\to\mathbb{R}$. If $g(i)\le 1$ for every $i\in\iota$, then the range of $g$ is bounded above.
replaced:
If $g : \iota \to \bbr$ satisfies $g(i) \le 1$ for every index $i$, then the range of
$g$ is bounded above.
